scenarios.title: Background Task
scenarios.expected: Register enabled / Unregister disabled / Status 'Unregistered' by default; Register registers a TimeZoneChange SystemTrigger task.

scenarios.title: Background Task with Condition
scenarios.expected: Same Register/Unregister/Status pattern; task carries an InternetAvailable condition.

scenarios.title: Background Task with Application Trigger
scenarios.expected: Register/Unregister/Status plus an application-trigger signal action.

scenarios.title: Grouped Background Task
scenarios.expected: Same Register/Unregister/Status pattern; registered within a task group.

gradingNotes: Each scenario is a faithful copy of the SDK page template: a Description, Register/Unregister buttons, and a Status line. Structural parity is judged by presence of the nav item (verbatim title), the Register/Unregister buttons, and the Status output. Behavioral parity (Register -> Status 'Registered', Unregister re-enabled) is permission-gated (BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync) and therefore environment-dependent.
